name: Trigger 1
description: When PT share of trips exceeds 0.245 trip share (0-1) for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 4-year lead time.

name: Trigger 2
description: When Annual passenger congestion delay exceeds 8.5e+06 person-hours/year for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 10-year lead time.
